description: Karpenter overview: health and autoscaling activity (interruptions, nodeclaim lifecycle, disruption pipeline, cost) plus the capacity and pod views from the kubernetes-autoscaling-mixin (gnetId 22171), repo-owned and corrected. Every query is validated against live Mimir by scripts/check-dashboard-queries.py.

panels.title: Cluster State
panels.description: karpenter_cluster_state_synced: Karpenter's view of the cluster is consistent. 0 means provisioning decisions are based on stale state.

panels.title: Unschedulable Pods
panels.description: Pods Karpenter sees as unschedulable right now. Sustained non-zero means capacity is not materializing.

panels.title: Spot Interruptions (24h)
panels.description: Spot interruption warnings received from the SQS interruption queue in the last 24h.

panels.title: Nodes Created (24h)
panels.description: Node churn, creation side.

panels.title: Nodes Terminated (24h)
panels.description: Node churn, termination side. Persistent creation/termination imbalance means capacity drift.

panels.title: Provisioned Cost
panels.description: Karpenter's estimate of the hourly cost of all provisioned capacity (karpenter_nodepools_cost_total, $/h).

panels.title: Interruption messages by type
panels.description: AWS interruption-queue traffic: spot interruptions, rebalance recommendations, scheduled changes, instance state changes.

panels.title: NodeClaim lifecycle
panels.description: Why capacity comes and goes: creations by trigger, disruptions by reason (spot_interrupted, underutilized, drifted), terminations.

panels.title: Disruption pipeline
panels.description: Voluntary disruption funnel (nodes eligible by reason, decisions taken) plus AWS API errors from the cloudprovider.

panels.title: Node Pools
panels.description: Counted from usage (not limits), so pools without spec.limits still count.

panels.title: Karpenter Nodes
panels.description: Nodes managed by Karpenter matching the current filters. Managed-node-group system nodes are not included.

targets.expr: count(group by (node_name) (karpenter_nodes_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type"}))

panels.title: Cluster CPU Utilization
panels.description: Karpenter's own cluster-wide CPU utilization estimate.

panels.title: Cluster Memory Utilization
panels.description: Karpenter's own cluster-wide memory utilization estimate.

panels.title: Pool CPU Limits
panels.description: Sum of NodePool spec.limits.cpu.

panels.title: Pool Memory Limits
panels.description: Sum of NodePool spec.limits.memory.

panels.title: CPU: allocatable vs requested
panels.description: True node allocatable vs scheduled requests and limits, all honoring the same filters. The old dashboard plotted pool capacity as 'Allocatable' and ignored the node filters on that series.

targets.expr: sum(karpenter_nodes_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"})

(sum(karpenter_nodes_total_pod_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(karpenter_nodes_total_daemon_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"}) or vector(0))

(sum(karpenter_nodes_total_pod_limits{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(karpenter_nodes_total_daemon_limits{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Memory: allocatable vs requested
panels.description: True node allocatable vs scheduled requests and limits.

targets.expr: sum(karpenter_nodes_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"})

(sum(karpenter_nodes_total_pod_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(karpenter_nodes_total_daemon_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"}) or vector(0))

(sum(karpenter_nodes_total_pod_limits{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(karpenter_nodes_total_daemon_limits{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Node Pool utilization vs limits
panels.description: Pool usage against spec.limits. Only cpu and memory have limits configured, so only those ratios exist.

targets.expr: sum by (nodepool, resource_type) (karpenter_nodepools_usage{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool"}) / sum by (nodepool, resource_type) (karpenter_nodepools_limit{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool"}) * 100

panels.title: Cost per Node Pool
panels.description: Hourly cost estimate per pool over time. Steps line up with NodeClaim lifecycle events.

targets.expr: count by (nodepool) (group by (node_name, nodepool) (karpenter_nodes_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type"}))

count by (instance_type) (group by (node_name, instance_type) (karpenter_nodes_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type"}))

count by (capacity_type) (group by (node_name, capacity_type) (karpenter_nodes_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type"}))

count by (zone) (group by (node_name, zone) (karpenter_nodes_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type"}))

(sum(karpenter_nodes_total_pod_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(karpenter_nodes_total_daemon_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"}) or vector(0))

(sum(karpenter_nodes_total_pod_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(karpenter_nodes_total_daemon_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Pod CPU Limits
panels.description: Both operands are zero-guarded: the upstream mixin summed pod+daemon limits without guards, and the absent daemonset CPU-limit series swallowed the whole sum.

targets.expr: (sum(karpenter_nodes_total_pod_limits{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(karpenter_nodes_total_daemon_limits{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"}) or vector(0))

(sum(karpenter_nodes_total_pod_limits{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(karpenter_nodes_total_daemon_limits{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Node Pools
panels.description: Per-pool usage, allocatable, and configured limits. The upstream mixin also rendered Nodes/Pods/Storage LIMIT columns, permanently blank here because the NodePools only set cpu and memory limits; those columns are dropped.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Per-node requested/allocatable utilization. Gauges run to 150% because Karpenter's cluster-state requests can transiently exceed allocatable during churn; the upstream mixin clamped at 100% and silently flattened the overshoot.

targets.expr: (sum by (node_name, nodepool, instance_type, capacity_type, zone) (karpenter_nodes_total_pod_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"}) + on (node_name) group_left() sum by (node_name) (karpenter_nodes_total_daemon_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"})) / on (node_name) group_left() sum by (node_name) (karpenter_nodes_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="cpu"}) * 100

(sum by (node_name, nodepool, instance_type, capacity_type, zone) (karpenter_nodes_total_pod_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"}) + on (node_name) group_left() sum by (node_name) (karpenter_nodes_total_daemon_requests{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"})) / on (node_name) group_left() sum by (node_name) (karpenter_nodes_allocatable{cluster="$cluster", job="karpenter", nodepool=~"$nodepool", zone=~"$zone", instance_type=~"$instance_type", capacity_type=~"$capacity_type", resource_type="memory"}) * 100
